title: RAGrasp: Geometry-Semantic Template Retrieval and Grasp Transfer
abstract: arXiv:2610.04438v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We present RAGrasp, a retrieval-augmented pipeline for planar parallel-jaw grasping from a compact set of locally collected, grasp-annotated RGB-D (color and depth) templates. Unlike task-specific predictors trained primarily on large public or synthetic grasp datasets, RAGrasp requires no end-to-end retraining for a new deployment.Its template memory is constructed from observations collected with the deployment camera, robot, and gripper in the target workspace, thereby aligning stored examples with the local sensing and embodiment conditions. The system uses self-supervised DINOv2 visual fea- tures together with appearance and depth cues to prompt the Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2), which isolates the query object. A two-stage geometry-semantic retrieval cascade then selects a template, and a confidence gate chooses one of two grasp- transfer estimators. The transferred grasp is refined using mask- support and silhouette-contact

translated_title: RAGrasp：几何-语义模板检索与抓取迁移
translated_abstract: 我们提出了RAGrasp，这是一个检索增强的流水线，用于基于一小组本地采集的、带有抓取标注的RGB-D（彩色与深度）模板实现平面平行夹爪抓取。与主要在大型公开或合成抓取数据集上训练的任务专用预测器不同，RAGrasp在新的部署环境中无需端到端重新训练。其模板记忆库由部署相机、机器人和夹爪在目标工作空间中采集的观测数据构建，从而使存储的样本与本地感知条件和本体配置保持一致。该系统利用自监督的DINOv2视觉特征，结合外观与深度线索来驱动Segment Anything Model 2（SAM2），以分割出查询目标物体。随后，两阶段的几何-语义检索级联选定一个模板，并由置信度门控从两种抓取迁移估计器中选择其一。迁移得到的抓取位姿再通过掩码支撑和轮廓接触（约束）进行优化。
tldr: RAGrasp是一个无需重新训练的检索增强抓取系统，通过本地采集的RGB-D模板库进行几何-语义检索与抓取迁移，使机器人抓取能快速适配新环境与硬件。
en_tdlr: RAGrasp is a retrieval-augmented grasping pipeline that requires no retraining for new deployments, leveraging locally collected RGB-D templates with geometry-semantic retrieval and grasp transfer for planar parallel-jaw grasping.
